why: the template for a video that is NOT a rebuild: an introduction slide (a title and a description) that says what the project is, then your own 16:9 clip as the whole window, then the claim and the lockup. Change the words, point popin.video at your clip (templates/pop-in/make-sample-clip.sh writes a stand-in), set the theme. Scene lengths are derived (the clip's length, the time the intro needs); add ms to a scene only to hold it longer.

claim.footnote: *Up to 1,000 tokens per second: Kimi on Cerebras.

intro.title: Your project's name
intro.description: What the agent is and does, and who it is for, in a sentence or two. The viewer reads this before the video starts.
